author: ADV-01, ADV-02 and ADV-03 from Om's wording (ADV-01 and ADV-02 reworded to avoid keywords, ADV-03 verbatim). ADV-04 to ADV-10 written by Claude from Om's list of kinds.
note: Adversarial tasks for Phase 2 of prds/jit-retrieval.md: indirect wording, near neighbors, and cases where the right answer is a gap or a refusal. The runner sends only user_prompt. kind, answer and why are for the person comparing results and are never sent to the model. Every answer here is PROPOSED by Claude from reading the rules, and Om has not corrected it yet. Rule ids were checked against the repo. Treat ADV-04 to ADV-10 as less independent than a set written by Om, because Claude knows the trees.
status: ADV-02, 06, 07 and 08 corrected by Om. The rest still proposed by Claude.

tasks.user_prompt: Let people see everything about a record without leaving the list.
tasks.answer: Row drawer. It pushes the table when DS-PANEL-003 passes, overlays otherwise, and is full screen below --breakpoint-md (DS-PANEL-002). PATH-B-ROW-OPEN.
tasks.why: A modal, a new page or an expandable row are plausible wrong picks.

tasks.user_prompt: People clean up old entries 30 at a time and sometimes remove the wrong ones.
tasks.answer: Bulk action bar with the destructive action last and distinct (PATH-TABLE-BULK-BAR). Then either a confirmation that states the count, when the removal cannot be undone, or an undo toast and no dialog, when it can (PATH-TABLE-BULK-DESTRUCTIVE). A good answer names the condition and says which applies. PATH-TABLE-ERROR-BULK-PARTIAL is a bonus.
tasks.why: The wording never says delete or bulk. The task does not say whether removal can be undone, so Om accepts either branch if the answer names the condition.

tasks.user_prompt: Show the full data string when the user hovers over a table cell
tasks.answer: Tooltip for short text (25 words or under, hover and focus). Not Popover (needs a click). Not HoverCard (touch never sees it).
tasks.why: The length is not stated, so a long string changes the answer. Kept verbatim from Om. A good answer notes the cell must also be reachable by keyboard focus.

tasks.user_prompt: While setting up an account, let people pick a few interests from a short list of tags.
tasks.answer: ToggleChip (a pill that toggles on and off, in a wrapping row, Select all and Clear over 6 chips). It is not in the registry yet (component-names status: build), so the answer should say so.
tasks.why: Tests whether the skill says a component is not built, instead of inventing one or defaulting to a checkbox list.

tasks.user_prompt: Use a modal to show each order's details when someone clicks a row in the orders table.
tasks.answer: Push back: use a row drawer, not a modal (PATH-B-ROW-OPEN, DS-PANEL-003).
tasks.why: Tests whether the skills correct the request or just obey it.

tasks.user_prompt: On a phone, show the full text of a truncated address in a table cell.
tasks.answer: Not Tooltip and not HoverCard, because touch never sees hover. Either a Popover opened by tapping the address, or the row's detail view with the full address (PATH-TABLE-NARROW-OPEN). Both count.
tasks.why: Same need as ADV-03 with a touch constraint.

tasks.user_prompt: Ask for a date of birth when someone signs up.
tasks.answer: A typed date field (field type `date`: text, numeric keyboard, MM/DD/YYYY hint in the user's locale order, stored as ISO, checked on blur), with no calendar popup. Keep the date of birth out of URLs and analytics (FIELD-SENSITIVE-STORAGE).
tasks.why: The date field type's own test note says birth dates need a different picker than near dates. A calendar popup is a poor fit for a birth year decades back.

tasks.user_prompt: Add a button that clears all the filters on a list, and say what it should be called.
tasks.answer: A text Button with the ghost or link variant, no icon. The label goes to righter and should be a short verb phrase.
tasks.why: Om chose ghost or link only. JOB-TRIGGER-ACTION does not say which variant fits a clear-filters action, so this part is Om's judgement, not a rule.

tasks.user_prompt: Build a live overlay that shows where each teammate's cursor is in a shared document.
tasks.answer: The skills have no spec for this (the presence indicator has no spec or token, see EVAL-026). The right answer says so, or says no match, and does not invent a rule.
tasks.why: Tests whether it admits a gap. No rule id to require. Om reads the reports: a made-up answer from the nearest component counts as a fail.

tasks.user_prompt: On a phone, let people remove several saved items at once and make sure they mean it.
tasks.answer: Selection mode entered by an explicit Select action, a bulk bar at the bottom with the destructive action last, and a confirmation (PATH-TABLE-NARROW-SELECT, PATH-TABLE-BULK-DESTRUCTIVE). A half-height sheet may also apply (DS-RESPONSIVE-008). A good answer names both and picks one.
tasks.why: Mobile bulk bar vs a half-height sheet for the confirm.
